title: Affine perfect support extension
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let T be a closed subset of X whose complement is quasi-compact, and let U be a quasi-compact open of X. For every perfect object F of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex] supported on T\cap U, there exists a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_X) supported on T such that E|_U is isomorphic to F\oplus F[1].
